description: This file defines two custom attribute classes, StorageProviderAttribute and LogConsistencyProviderAttribute, used to specify storage and consistency providers for grains in the Orleans framework. It includes metadata and default values for these attributes.

classes.name: StorageProviderAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to specify the storage provider for grain persistence.

classes.name: LogConsistencyProviderAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to specify the log consistency provider for grains using log-view state.

methods.name: StorageProviderAttribute()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ProviderName to default storage provider name.

methods.name: LogConsistencyProviderAttribute()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ProviderName to default log consistency provider name.
